zoe (docs): Opening a short PR to unify examples for quota/usage analytics, include SDK snippets, and link to Grafana panels. Draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2701 :wave:

rafa (eng-platform): Thanks. Two quick items: ensure examples use X-RW-Usage (recent header rename) and include a mapping note for older clients still using X-Usage-Tokens.

zoe (docs): Will update. I'm making hourly aggregation the canonical example for billing docs and keeping a 1m ops variant.

nora (product): Agree hourly primary. Also add a sentence that the dashboard "available" equals committed tier + burst; billing reconciles on daily UTC windows.

ken (devex): Add a short JS SDK snippet showing how to parse series points for group_by=1h vs group_by=1m. People frequently misread ordering. Minimal example is fine.

zoe (docs): Adding this curl + JS pair in the PR:

```
# curl: last hour, per-minute buckets
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-RW-Usage: project=acme,env=prod" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1m"
```

```js
// hourly aggregation example
const res = await fetch('/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1h',{ headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'X-RW-Usage': 'project=acme,env=prod' }});
const body = await res.json();
console.log(body.series[0].points.map(p => p.value));
```

rafa (eng-platform): Nice. Also include a Grafana permalink to panel id 42 for consumption overview and a one-liner troubleshooting tip for rollouts: "If totals double during canary->stable migration, check routing headers and unique meter_key per route."

zoe (docs): Added panel link + troubleshooting callout. I also added a short note: "Fallback routing to compatible model variants can change which model meter receives tokens; use per-route snapshots to reconcile attribution."

nora (product): Looks good. After CI, tag me and Rafa. Also please file a follow-up issue to add a small prompt set that stresses token churn so Optimize can recommend batching; not required to land this PR.
